offer.text: Every map I draw ends at the same void. Reach the End itself and tell me what lies past the edge.

accept.text: No cartographer has charted it and returned. Be the first.

decline.text: The blank space at the world's rim will have to wait.

in_progress.text: Have you found the way to the End?

ready.text: You stood at the edge of everything! Quickly — before you forget the shape of it.

complete.text: This map will bear your name at its farthest corner. Legendary.
